title: I don't watch cricket very often.
goal_hi: Apni aadat aur routine ke baare me negative sentence aur sawal batana.

dialogue.title: Lunch with a colleague
dialogue.context_hi: Office canteen, lunch break. Colleague se gym aur free time ki baat.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: You're not going to the gym today?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No, I don't go to the gym very often. I usually walk in the evening.
lines.hi: Nahi, main bahut zyada baar gym nahi jaata. Main aam taur par shaam ko paidal chalta hoon.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I don't watch cricket very often either. I prefer movies.
lines.hi: Main bhi bahut zyada baar cricket nahi dekhti. Mujhe movies pasand hain.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Same here. I watch a movie on Sunday, but not every week.
lines.hi: Mere saath bhi wahi. Main Sunday ko movie dekhta hoon, par har hafte nahi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I like walking. It's simple and I don't need a gym.
lines.hi: Mujhe paidal chalna pasand hai. Simple hai aur gym ki zarurat nahi.

sound_focus.tip_hi: Sentence rhythm: content words par stress do — I DON'T WATCH CRICKET very often. 'very often' ko jaldi bolo.
